errors.invalidRequest: Something you entered isn’t right. Check it and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: You’re signed out. Sign in to carry on.
errors.accessEnded: Your access has ended. Ask the admin if you think this is a mistake.
errors.forbidden: You can’t do this. Ask the admin if you need to.
errors.notFound: This no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
errors.adminExists: FPR already has an admin. Sign in instead.
errors.colorTaken: Someone has just taken this colour. Pick another one.
errors.emailTaken: Someone else already uses this email. Enter another one.
errors.isinTaken: Another share already has this ISIN. Open that share instead.
errors.shareInUse: Someone holds or held this share, so it can’t be deleted.
errors.shareNotNeedingAttention: This share’s prices are coming in again, so it stays a market share.
errors.valueChanged: Someone changed this value in the meantime. Check the new value, then confirm again.
errors.refreshRunning: Prices are already refreshing. Try again in a minute.
errors.avatarTooLarge: This picture is too large. Pick one under 2 MB.
errors.avatarTypeUnsupported: This picture’s format isn’t supported. Pick a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
errors.invalidAccessKey: This access link doesn’t work. Ask the admin for a new one.
errors.invalidResetKey: This email and reset key don’t match, or the key has expired. Ask the admin for a new key.
errors.invalidBootstrapKey: This setup key is wrong. Check the key in the server’s configuration.
errors.holdingBelowZero: This would take a holding below zero. Check the quantity and the date.
errors.futureMoment: This date is in the future. Pick today or an earlier day.
errors.lastAdmin: FPR needs at least one admin. Make someone else admin first.
errors.hasPortfolioEntries: This person has a portfolio, so they can’t become a guest. Delete their entries first.
errors.anonymousRoleFixed: An anonymous viewer stays anonymous. Add a new person with the role you need.
errors.lastValuePoint: A manual share keeps at least one value. Add another value before deleting this one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.callBudgetUsed: Today’s price lookups are used up. Try again tomorrow.
errors.internalError: Something went wrong on FPR’s side. Try again in a moment.
errors.providerUnavailable: The price provider isn’t answering. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unreachable: FPR can’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
